shorts.hook: When orcas attack, a sperm whale family turns into a flower.
shorts.title: Sperm Whales Turn Into a Flower When Orcas Attack
shorts.outro: All six of Doug's deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: Hunted sperm whale families form a daisy-shaped ring with their calves in the middle, and the full episode shows what happens next.

shorts.title: Researchers Never Saw a Sperm Whale Strike an Orca
shorts.outro: Doug's six deaths and the four-hour attack are in the full video below.
shorts.description: Five-meter flukes, fifteen tons of whale, and four hours of orca attacks without one aimed blow; the full episode explains why.

shorts.hook: Orcas dragged one sperm whale out. Its family went back.
shorts.title: Orcas Pulled One Whale Out. The Family Went Back for It
shorts.outro: Doug's six deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: Every time orcas dragged a sperm whale from the ring, others swam out to bring it back; watch the full episode for the rest of the attack.
